_Original comment by_ **Claudiu Popa (BitBucket: [PCManticore](http://bitbucket.org/PCManticore), GitHub: @PCManticore)**:

---

I don't understand, what's the error? I tried to follow your steps for reproducing this, but nothing strange happened.

_Original comment by_ **Claudiu Popa (BitBucket: [PCManticore](http://bitbucket.org/PCManticore), GitHub: @PCManticore)**:

---

Now I understand, at step 1.5 there should have been a deprecated-message emitted. Actually Pylint will emit there an import-error, since it can't find the given module. Any other import related message is emitted only if Pylint can find the given module, so this is not a problem per se.

_Original comment by_ **BitBucket: [moylop260](http://bitbucket.org/moylop260), GitHub: @moylop260?**:

---

I have a travis build with just pylint cases.

This is faster because I don't have installed any package.

All checks work fine!

I have disabled `import-error` but I have enabled `deprecated-module`
But I have that install all packages deprecated to see this check.

Is there a way to show deprecate-module without install packages?

_Original comment by_ **Claudiu Popa (BitBucket: [PCManticore](http://bitbucket.org/PCManticore), GitHub: @PCManticore)**:

---

Might be worth a fix after all.

_Original comment by_ **Claudiu Popa (BitBucket: [PCManticore](http://bitbucket.org/PCManticore), GitHub: @PCManticore)**:

---

I don't have time right now to look into this, since I have my hands full with preparing 1.5 release, but I'll gladly help any contributor that wants to tackle this issue.

_Original comment by_ **BitBucket: [moylop260](http://bitbucket.org/moylop260), GitHub: @moylop260?**:

---

I don't know use mercurial and bitbucket, but the patch could be this one:

``` diff
diff -r 67c23b08e720 pylint/checkers/imports.py
--- a/pylint/checkers/imports.py        Wed Sep 23 14:03:23 2015 +0300
+++ b/pylint/checkers/imports.py        Sat Sep 26 09:45:50 2015 -0500
@@ -278,6 +278,7 @@
                         and prev.modname == '__future__'):
                     self.add_message('misplaced-future', node=node)
             return
+        self._check_deprecated_module(node, basename)
         for name, _ in node.names:
             if name == '*':
                 self.add_message('wildcard-import', args=basename, node=node)
@@ -286,7 +287,6 @@
         if importedmodnode is None:
             return
         self._check_relative_import(modnode, node, importedmodnode, basename)
-        self._check_deprecated_module(node, basename)

         for name, _ in node.names:
             if name != '*':
```
